description: Search for Google Documents using various filters including name, content, date ranges, and more.

query.title: Query
query.description: Search query to filter documents. Provide either: (1) Plain text to search in document content (e.g., 'quarterly report'), which will search fullText, or (2) Drive API query syntax with operators like 'name contains', 'fullText contains', combined with 'and', 'or', 'not'. Leave empty to get all documents.
query.human_parameter_description: Provide the search terms to find documents. You can search by document names or content.

order_by.title: Order By
order_by.description: Order results by field. Common options: 'modifiedTime desc', 'modifiedTime asc', 'name', 'createdTime desc'
order_by.human_parameter_description: Choose how to sort the search results; for instance, by the time they were modified or their names.

page_token.title: Page Token
page_token.description: Token for continuing a previous search request on the next page. Use the next_page_token from the previous response to retrieve additional results.
page_token.human_parameter_description: If you received a next_page_token in a previous response, provide it here to get the next page of results.

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of documents to return per page (1-100). Defaults to 10. Use page_token for pagination when more results are available.
max_results.human_parameter_description: Specify how many documents you want returned in the search results. The default is 10. Maximum is 100 per page.

starred_only.title: Starred Only
starred_only.description: Whether to return only starred documents. Defaults to False.
starred_only.human_parameter_description: Select this option if you only want to see documents that you have marked as important.

created_after.title: Created After
created_after.description: Return documents created after this date. Use RFC 3339 format like '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'.
created_after.human_parameter_description: Provide a date to see only documents that were created after that time.

modified_after.title: Modified After
modified_after.description: Return documents modified after this date. Use RFC 3339 format like '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'.
modified_after.human_parameter_description: Input a date to find documents that have been changed since then.

shared_with_me.title: Shared With Me
shared_with_me.description: Whether to return only documents shared with the current user. Defaults to False.
shared_with_me.human_parameter_description: Choose to only display documents that other users have shared with you.

include_trashed.title: Include Trashed
include_trashed.description: Whether to include documents in trash. Defaults to False.
include_trashed.human_parameter_description: Decide if you want to see documents that have been moved to the trash.

response_detail.title: Response Detail
response_detail.description: Level of detail in the response. 'minimal' returns only essential fields (id, name, modifiedTime, webViewLink) for efficient token usage. 'full' returns comprehensive metadata including permissions, owners, timestamps, and other detailed information.
response_detail.human_parameter_description: Choose the level of detail you want. Use 'minimal' for quick scanning of documents, or 'full' for complete metadata.

include_shared_drives.title: Include Shared Drives
include_shared_drives.description: Whether to include documents from shared drives you have access to. Defaults to True.
include_shared_drives.human_parameter_description: Include documents from shared drives (team drives) you have access to in the search results.

revision_id.description: The revision ID of the label.

owners.title: Owners
owners.description: The owner of this file. Only certain legacy files may have more than one owner.

shared.title: Shared
shared.description: Whether the file has been shared.

starred.description: Whether the user has starred the file.

trashed.title: Trashed
trashed.description: Whether the file has been trashed, either explicitly or from a trashed parent folder.

version.title: Version
version.description: A monotonically increasing version number for the file. This reflects every change made to the file on the server, even those not visible to the user.

drive_id.title: Drive Id
drive_id.description: ID of the shared drive the file resides in. Only populated for items in shared drives.

icon_link.title: Icon Link

mime_type.description: The MIME type of the file.

label_info.title: Label Info
label_info.description: An overview of the labels on the file.

owned_by_me.title: Owned By Me
owned_by_me.description: Whether the user owns the file.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: The full list of permissions for the file.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Capabilities the current user has on this file. Each capability corresponds to a fine-grained action that a user may take.

created_time.title: Created Time
created_time.description: The time at which the file was created (RFC 3339 date-time).

export_links.title: Export Links
export_links.description: Links for exporting Docs Editors files to specific formats.

md5_checksum.title: Md5 Checksum
md5_checksum.description: The MD5 checksum for the content of the file. This is only applicable to files with binary content in Google Drive.

resource_key.title: Resource Key
resource_key.description: A key needed to access the item via a shared link.

sharing_user.title: Sharing User
sharing_user.description: The user who shared the file with the requesting user, if applicable.

trashed_time.title: Trashed Time
trashed_time.description: The time that the item was trashed (RFC 3339 date-time).

viewed_by_me.title: Viewed By Me

content_hints.description: Additional information about the content of the file. These fields are never populated in responses.

has_thumbnail.description: Whether this file has a thumbnail. This does not indicate whether the requesting app has access to the thumbnail.

modified_time.title: Modified Time
modified_time.description: The last time the file was modified by anyone (RFC 3339 date-time).

sha1_checksum.title: Sha1 Checksum
sha1_checksum.description: The SHA1 checksum associated with this file, if available.

trashing_user.title: Trashing User
trashing_user.description: If the file has been explicitly trashed, the user who trashed it.

web_view_link.title: Web View Link
web_view_link.description: A link for opening the file in a relevant Google editor or viewer in a browser.

app_properties.title: App Properties
app_properties.description: A collection of arbitrary key-value pairs which are private to the requesting app.

file_extension.title: File Extension
file_extension.description: The final component of fullFileExtension. This is only available for files with binary content in Google Drive.

modified_by_me.title: Modified By Me
modified_by_me.description: Whether the file has been modified by this user.

permission_ids.title: Permission Ids
permission_ids.description: List of permission IDs for users with access to this file.

thumbnail_link.title: Thumbnail Link
thumbnail_link.description: A short-lived link to the file's thumbnail, if available. Typically lasts on the order of hours.

sha256_checksum.title: Sha256 Checksum
sha256_checksum.description: The SHA256 checksum associated with this file, if available.

folder_color_rgb.title: Folder Color Rgb

head_revision_id.title: Head Revision Id
head_revision_id.description: The ID of the file's head revision.

quota_bytes_used.title: Quota Bytes Used

shortcut_details.title: Shortcut Details
shortcut_details.description: Shortcut file details. Only populated for shortcut files.

web_content_link.title: Web Content Link
web_content_link.description: A link for downloading the content of the file in a browser. This is only available for files with binary content in Google Drive.

is_app_authorized.title: Is App Authorized
is_app_authorized.description: Whether the file was created or opened by the requesting app.

original_filename.title: Original Filename
original_filename.description: The original filename of the uploaded content if available, or else the original value of the name field.

thumbnail_version.title: Thumbnail Version
thumbnail_version.description: The thumbnail version for use in thumbnail cache invalidation.

viewed_by_me_time.title: Viewed By Me Time
viewed_by_me_time.description: The last time the file was viewed by the user (RFC 3339 date-time).

writers_can_share.title: Writers Can Share
writers_can_share.description: Whether users with only writer permission can modify the file's permissions.

explicitly_trashed.title: Explicitly Trashed
explicitly_trashed.description: Whether the file has been explicitly trashed, as opposed to recursively trashed from a parent folder.

full_file_extension.title: Full File Extension
full_file_extension.description: The full file extension extracted from the name field. May contain multiple concatenated extensions.

last_modifying_user.title: Last Modifying User
last_modifying_user.description: The last user to modify the file.

link_share_metadata.title: Link Share Metadata
link_share_metadata.description: Contains details about the link URLs that clients are using to refer to this item.

modified_by_me_time.title: Modified By Me Time
modified_by_me_time.description: The last time the file was modified by the user (RFC 3339 date-time).

shared_with_me_time.title: Shared With Me Time
shared_with_me_time.description: The time at which the file was shared with the user, if applicable (RFC 3339 date-time).

content_restrictions.title: Content Restrictions
content_restrictions.description: Restrictions for accessing the content of the file.

image_media_metadata.title: Image Media Metadata
image_media_metadata.description: Additional metadata about image media, if available.

video_media_metadata.title: Video Media Metadata
video_media_metadata.description: Additional metadata about video media. This may not be available immediately upon upload.

has_augmented_permissions.title: Has Augmented Permissions
has_augmented_permissions.description: Whether there are permissions directly on this file.

inherited_permissions_disabled.title: Inherited Permissions Disabled
inherited_permissions_disabled.description: Whether inherited permissions have been disabled for this file.

copy_requires_writer_permission.title: Copy Requires Writer Permission
copy_requires_writer_permission.description: Whether the options to copy, print, or download this file, should be disabled for readers and commenters.
